output.reason: The release note [ev-2bd1a74f9c4a] says the defaults now disable policy exceptions and allow them only in a specified namespace. It defers the details to upgrade guidance that is not among the excerpts. The renders show the chart-default `--enablePolicyException` argument changing from true to false on all three controllers [ev-b39e8c27b4a6][ev-e599ee1bf192][ev-89fe173dc4ac][ev-87f3f8d70a09][ev-f85ade3c8a00]. That means environments that explicitly keep exceptions enabled are shielded, so `gvk-in-use` PolicyException on its own is too broad. A precise condition still can't be written: the chart always renders the flag, so `cli-flag unset` never matches, and no evidence names the Helm values key that controls the flag or the setting for the exception namespace. We need the 1.13 upgrade guidance or the chart values that set `--enablePolicyException` and the allowed exception namespace.
